positions.name: NewHireOnboardingProcess
positions.frame: What does onboarding a new hire consist of — which steps a first week runs through, and what practice it displaced?
positions.why: One unhedged declarative carries a whole frame by itself: it names the standing first-week practice (Pallasine checklist, accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) as a generic habitual present, then anchors that practice in a settled past event ('replaced the old wiki page last quarter'). The temporal read holds a present-tense standing pattern against a past-tense replacement, and the conviction read is flat claim rather than performed decision — the group coheres as a description of what the process is, not as a ratification of it.
